conclusion_scope: Standard edge-ring interpretation of the graph ring of the finite simple complete graph; no mathematical truth verdict or solution strategy.

external_queries: toric ideal graph edge ring definition k[x_i x_j] Markov basis definition

external_sources_used_only_for_terminolo.purpose: conventional edge ring and its presentation kernel
toric ideal and Markov generating-set terminology

incidental_exposure: Required README general leaderboards and disclaimer
Search-result snippets for unrelated mathematical papers

objects.graph: Undirected loopless complete simple graph K_n
objects.domain: Positive integer n; natural-number formalization may state and handle the optional n=0 extension
objects.coefficient_field: Arbitrary field, or field-independent standard fiber formulation
objects.toric_ideal: Kernel of k[y_ij : i<j] -> k[x_i], y_ij maps to x_i*x_j
objects.quadratic_degree: Total degree 2 in edge variables y_ij
objects.markov_basis: Finite binomial generating set; equivalently finite moves connecting every nonnegative integer incidence fiber
objects.minimality: Not required; existence is equivalent under the inclusion-minimal convention

target.predicate: Q(n) means there exists a finite entirely quadratic Markov basis of the stated toric ideal
target.assertion: For every positive integer n, Q(n) iff n <= 5
clauses: For every n <= 5 in the domain, Q(n)
For every n in the domain, Q(n) implies n <= 5
disproof: Some positive n <= 5 with not Q(n)
target.source_parentheticals: Repeated quadratic label adds no stated independent property; Hosten-Sullivant remark gives context rather than an extra predicate

acceptable_formalization.edge_index: Unordered distinct vertex pairs, equivalently ordered pairs i<j
acceptable_formalization.incidence: A(u)(v) is the sum of edge multiplicities incident at v
acceptable_formalization.move: Distinct exponent pairs (a,b) with equal incidence and both total degrees 2
acceptable_formalization.connectivity: For every u,v with A(u)=A(v), finite path using either orientation of a move plus a common nonnegative context
acceptable_formalization.algebraic_bridge: Report must explicitly connect the exact standard fiber definition to the toric-kernel formulation; custom weaker predicates are unacceptable

reject_substitutes: Different graph-associated ring without source clarification
Degree 2 measured only in vertex variables
Existence of a quadratic relation without full generation
Integer lattice span without all-fiber connectivity
Only simple graphs or squarefree exponent vectors
Only bounded fibers without a proved exhaustive reduction
Failure of one candidate basis used as nonexistence of every basis
Failure of a stronger Groebner-basis property used as failure of Markov-basis existence
Truth or falsity of only an incorrect implication
later_review_requirements: Full LaTeX report and matching PDF
No sorry, native_decide, extra axioms, or unproved bridge carrying the result
All relied-upon auxiliary computations reproducible and exhaustive for their claims
Personal submission scope and required path conventions
